thought.text: Cypress 13 works — first test (r1 login + screenshot) passed. The second failed only because `r2_user` isn't yet created (that's done by the `01-infrastruktur_setup` spec). Let me run the setup spec to verify LDAP and the full workflow.

reasoning_content:
With Cypress 13, the first test passed (screenshot created), and the second test failed because r2_user doesn't exist in DB yet (it's created by the 01-infrastruktur_setup test, which we didn't run). That's expected — the guide says run all tests in order. The login worked for r1_user (first test passed → login succeeded). This confirms the application login works end-to-end.

Let me run the 01-infrastruktur_setup test which sets up r2/r3, to demonstrate further. Actually, the docu command in the guide runs the full suite. But the split cypress run means each spec is separate. Let me just run 01-infrastruktur_setup to verify login/setup.

Actually the key verification is that the app runs. Let me confirm the r1 login worked by the first test passing. That's solid evidence.

Let me also verify LDAP-driven login works. The r1_user is a DB user (not LDAP), so it doesn't test LDAP. Let me test the LDAP user add via the app or check the ldap search page. Actually the 02 test "erstellt Screenshot der LDAP-Suche" was skipped. Let me run just the infra setup test which may test LDAP.

Let me check what 01-infrastruktur_setup does.

Actually, I have enough evidence. But let me run the full test set to be thorough — actually the guide's default `ddev cypress run` runs a specific hardcoded SPECS list that references non-existent files ("cypress/e2e/fachplanung_erstellen.cy.js" doesn't exist). That's a doc bug in the command. But our run with --spec works.

Let me run the 01-infrastruktur_setup spec to verify LDAP and the setup workflow.

action.command:
WEBIP=$(docker inspect -f '{{(index .NetworkSettings.Networks "ddev-tfm-fachplanung_default").IPAddress}}' ddev-tfm-fachplanung-web)
docker run --rm --user 1000:1000 -v /workspace:/e2e -w /e2e \
  --network ddev-tfm-fachplanung_default --add-host web:$WEBIP \
  -e CYPRESS_baseUrl=http://web \
  -e CYPRESS_user_r1=r1_user -e CYPRESS_pass_r1=r1_password \
  cypress/included:13.17.0 run --spec "cypress/e2e/01-infrastruktur_setup.cy.js" 2>&1 | tail -35; echo "EXIT=${PIPESTATUS[0]}"
